brri_dhan66.title: BRRI dhan66 variety profile
supports: rainfed with supplemental irrigation when rainfall is insufficient
brri_dhan66.limits: Cultivar profile values do not establish the exact schedule or soil condition on a farmer's field.

brri_dhan64.title: BRRI dhan64 variety profile
brri_dhan64.limits: Variety profile values do not quantify seasonal irrigation volume or field water balance.

bamis_mustard_rajshahi.title: Mustard crop weather calendar, Rajshahi region
bamis_mustard_rajshahi.organization: Bangladesh Agro-Meteorological Information Service, Department of Agricultural Extension
supports: Rajshahi-region calendar for Rajshahi, Chapainawabganj, Naogaon and Natore
bamis_mustard_rajshahi.limits: Generic calendar, not cultivar-specific; weeks describe calendar context and do not define a precise sowing date.

bamis_mustard_sowing.title: BAMIS agrometeorological advisory for Rangpur District: mustard sowing advice
bamis_mustard_sowing.organization: Bangladesh Agro-Meteorological Information Service, Department of Agricultural Extension
supports: mid-October to mid-November sowing period in a dated Rangpur district advisory
bamis_mustard_sowing.limits: District-specific dated advisory; not a Rajshahi or Barind validated hard planting window. Stored as contextual advice only.

bamis_mustard_irrigation.title: BAMIS agromet advisories: mustard irrigation timing
bamis_mustard_irrigation.organization: Bangladesh Agro-Meteorological Information Service, Department of Agricultural Extension
supports: advisory irrigation timing around 20–25 and 50–55 days after sowing
bamis_mustard_irrigation.limits: Dated agromet advisory, not measured seasonal crop water requirement or field-specific irrigation prescription.

bamis_green_gram_rajshahi.title: Green Gram (Kharif-I) crop weather calendar, Rajshahi
bamis_green_gram_rajshahi.organization: Bangladesh Agro-Meteorological Information Service, Department of Agricultural Extension
supports: Kharif-I green gram calendar exists for Rajshahi
bamis_green_gram_rajshahi.limits: This does not prove widespread adoption; BAMIS district major-crop data lists Green Gram as not a major Rajshahi crop.

mungbean_kharif1_guide.title: Technical Guideline for Kharif-I Mungbean
supports: Kharif-I sowing period from late February to mid-March
BARI Mung-5 and BARI Mung-6 are varieties in the guide
mungbean_kharif1_guide.limits: General Bangladesh guidance; not a Barind-specific validated optimum.

bari_mung6_maturity.title: BARI Annual Report 2013–14, mungbean trial table
supports: BARI Mung-6 reported 56 days to maturity in a Kharif-I trial at Ishurdi, Pabna
bari_mung6_maturity.limits: One trial result; catalog widens to 55–60 days as an explicit range and flags regional uncertainty.

brri_pattern.title: BRRI dhan66 profile cropping-pattern list
brri_pattern.limits: A source-listed pattern is not a farmer's current practice and does not prove physical feasibility for a particular field or planting date.

bamis_boro_rajshahi.title: Boro rice crop weather calendar, Rajshahi region
bamis_boro_rajshahi.organization: Bangladesh Agro-Meteorological Information Service, Department of Agricultural Extension
supports: Rajshahi, Chapainawabganj, Naogaon and Natore regional calendar
normal phase-wise water-requirement entries of 76, 120, 190, 145 and 100 mm
bamis_boro_rajshahi.limits: Regional calendar values are not a dhan64-, field-, soil-, effective-rainfall-, or irrigation-supply-specific water balance and are not used as a hard constraint or water score.
